## 5. How `householdId` is currently computed/assigned

Two functions cooperate; both compare on **(normalized lastName, normalized address)** — NOT postcode.

```java
public static String deriveHouseholdId(String normalizedLastName, String normalizedAddress) {
    return "H-" + sha256Hex(normalizedLastName + '|' + normalizedAddress, 12);

```
`normalizeName` = trim + collapse whitespace + lowercase. Address is normalized by `OwnerAddress.normalize` (trim/collapse, upper-case, expand `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`).

`AssignHouseholdId.service` (pipeline step `assignHousehold`): scans `ownerRepository.findAll()`, collects existing owners with matching normalized lastName+address. It always sets `householdSize = matches + 1`. If there are no peers it returns leaving `householdId` null. Otherwise it sets `owner.householdId = deriveHouseholdId(...)` and **back-fills** any peer whose `householdId` is null/blank (saving them). ## 6. How duplicate detection currently works

There are **two mechanisms**, both keyed off `OwnerIdentity`:

**Hard duplicate → 409** — `EnsureIdentityUnique` (pipeline step `ensureUniqueIdentity`, runs early). The identity key is:

identityKey = canonicalTelephone(telephone) + '|' + normalizedEmail(email) + '|' + householdId
```

A household peer is compared using the shared `newHousehold` even if not yet back-filled. Any exact whole-key match throws `DuplicateIdentityException`, handled globally as HTTP 409 with body `{"errors":["identityKey"]}`. This deliberately subsumes the former separate telephone/email/household checks — same-household members with **different** telephones are allowed; only a full-key match is a duplicate.

**Soft duplicate → flag, still created** — `FlagPossibleDuplicate` (step `flagPossibleDuplicate`, runs just before `save`). static int membershipLevel(Owner owner) {

    boolean hasEmail = owner.getEmail() != null && !owner.getEmail().isBlank();
    if (hasEmail) level++;
    Integer namesakeCount = owner.getNamesakeCount();
    if (namesakeCount != null && namesakeCount == 0) level++;
    return Math.min(level, 3);

```
So: start 1; +1 if email present; +1 if the name was unique on creation (`namesakeCount == 0`, set by `CountNamesakes`); capped at 3. components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the city's
            region per the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present, drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only override for create. When true, the owner may be created even though an
            existing owner has the same lastName and address; when absent or false, such a request is
            rejected with 409. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the REGION component of the customerCode
                ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode yields no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region
                code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same lastName and
                address). Assigned when an owner joins an existing owner's household via
                'sharesHousehold'; null for an owner with no shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                where email is the lower-cased email or empty and householdId is the household id or empty.
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey is equal; a create whose
                identityKey matches an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|H-3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count

    ProblemDetail:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'

          title: Email address

          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode

          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'

          type: string

        - type: object
          properties:

              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the REGION component of the customerCode
                ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode yields no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region
                code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized lastName and postcode. Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode resolve to the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where email is the
                lower-cased email or empty and householdId is the deterministic household id.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the
                owner's name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise

              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

              title: Pets

          required:

## What I changed

The household is now keyed on **(lastName, postcode)** with a deterministic id, replacing the old (lastName, address) "peer-linking" model.

**`EnsureIdentityUnique`** (the 409 gate) — rewritten to key off the computed householdId: if `sharesHousehold` is true it bypasses the block entirely; otherwise any existing owner with the same computed householdId (same lastName+postcode) triggers `DuplicateIdentityException` → 409.

**`FlagPossibleDuplicate`** — a declared household member (`sharesHousehold == true`) is now short-circuited and never flagged as a possible duplicate, per "a declared member is not a suspected duplicate."

- Both duplicate detection and the household-size figure key off the computed `householdId`.
